study_identification_part.si_4_title: GPT- based normative models of brain sMRI correlate with dimensional psychopathology

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The architecture is composed of a Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) to compress brain images into discrete codes and a Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) to model the likelihood of these codes.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The architecture used in both studies is composed of two models. The first, called Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ- VAE) ... The second, a Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT)

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study used VBM-preprocessed Gray Matter (GM) and White Matter (WM) volumetric maps as input to the models.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The VBM preprocessing ... resulted in two matrices (i.e., GM and WM), each with a dimension of 181x217x181 voxels. We considered only the GM and WM to ensure that only brain tissue data would be delivered to the neural networks

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative models were trained unconditionally using only data from typically developing subjects, without including any explanatory variables (covariates) like age or sex in the model architecture.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Models were trained from typical development subjects (only), using the lower quartiles of CBCL total score from the ABCD dataset. ... A possible way to circumvent the limitations ... is to condition the models' estimation based on context to have a demographic- dependent likelihood estimation
